create_metric_evaluate_detections: create a MeanAveragePrecision metric to evaluate object detection predictions against ground truth targets
compute_map_result: compute MeanAveragePrecisionResult with map50, map75, and map50_95 scores from prediction and target detections
build_coco_evaluation_dataset: build an EvaluationDataset from COCO-format ground truth annotations for object detection evaluation
run_coco_evaluator: run COCOEvaluator to compute precision, recall, and IoU metrics between targets and predictions
configure_evaluation_parameters: configure COCOEvaluatorParameters with IoU thresholds, recall thresholds, and area ranges for mAP computation
